title: The Charge
subtitle: Charge phase: declare, roll 2D6, close the distance
subtitle_orky: Charge phase: declare, roll 2D6, get stuck in

bullets: Pick the charging unit, tick the target(s) in the list, then [b]Declare Charge[/b].
[b]Roll 2D6[/b] — that's how far every model can move. Too short and the charge fails.
A [b]Command Re-roll[/b] (1 CP) gets offered on the charge roll — take it if you came up short.
[b]Snap to Contact[/b] moves the whole squad into base contact; drag them yourself if you want it tidy.
[b]Confirm Charge Moves[/b] locks it. Charging units fight first next phase.
Next lesson: Close Combat — the Fight phase.
bullets_orky: Pick da chargin' unit, tick da target(s) in da list, den [b]Declare Charge[/b].
[b]Roll 2D6[/b] — dat's how far every model can move. Too short an' da charge fails.
A [b]Command Re-roll[/b] (1 CP) gets offered on da charge roll — take it if ya came up short.
[b]Snap to Contact[/b] shoves da whole mob into base contact; drag 'em yerself if ya want it tidy.
[b]Confirm Charge Moves[/b] locks it. Chargin' units fight first next phase.
Next lesson: Krumpin' — da Fight phase.

prompt.text: The Boyz have shot them up — now they want to close in. Charging is three steps: [b]declare[/b] who you want, [b]roll[/b] 2D6, then [b]move[/b] into contact. Fail the roll and they don't move at all.
prompt.text_orky: Da Boyz shot 'em up — now dey wanna get stuck in. Chargin' is three steps: [b]declare[/b] who ya want, [b]roll[/b] 2D6, den [b]move[/b] into contact. Fail da roll an' dey don't move at all.

prompt.kbm: Click the [b]Boyz[/b] in the unit list, then pick the [b]Custodian Guard[/b] — click them in the target list [i]or[/i] just click them on the board. Then hit [b]Declare Charge[/b].
prompt.kbm_orky: Click da [b]Boyz[/b] in da unit list, den pick da [b]Custodian Guard[/b] — click 'em in da target list [i]or[/i] just click da gits on da board. Den hit [b]Declare Charge[/b].
prompt.pad: Tap {rb} till the [b]Boyz[/b] are selected. {dpad} ◀▶ walks the target ring — put it on the [b]Custodian Guard[/b] and press {a} to toggle them in. Then {menu} to [b]Declare Charge[/b].
prompt.pad_orky: Tap {rb} till da [b]Boyz[/b] are picked. {dpad} ◀▶ walks da target ring — put it on da [b]Custodian Guard[/b] an' press {a} to toggle 'em in. Den {menu} to [b]Declare Charge[/b].

hint.text: You can declare more than one target — but every one of them gets to shoot Overwatch back.
hint.text_orky: Ya can declare more dan one target — but every one of 'em gets to shoot Overwatch back.

prompt.kbm: Hit [b]Roll 2D6[/b]. Whatever you roll is how many inches [i]every[/i] model in the squad gets — and they all have to end up within engagement range for it to count.
prompt.kbm_orky: Hit [b]Roll 2D6[/b]. Whatever ya roll is how many inches [i]every[/i] model in da mob gets — an' dey all gotta end up wivin engagement range for it to count.

hint.text: The panel shows the rolled distance right after — that's your budget.
hint.text_orky: Da panel shows da rolled distance right after — dat's yer budget.

prompt.text: Nine inches — plenty. The game offers a [b]Command Re-roll[/b] on any charge roll (1 CP) in case you come up short; we don't need it. Click [b]Keep Roll[/b].
prompt.text_orky: Nine inches — plenty. Da game offers a [b]Command Re-roll[/b] on any charge roll (1 CP) in case ya come up short; we don't need it. Click [b]Keep Roll[/b].
prompt.pad: The re-roll offer takes its own {dpad}/{a} — pick [b]Keep Roll[/b] and press {a}.
prompt.pad_orky: Da re-roll offer takes its own {dpad}/{a} — pick [b]Keep Roll[/b] an' press {a}.

hint.text: Keep Roll — save the CP. You'd only re-roll if the charge fell short.
hint.text_orky: Keep Roll — save da CP. Ya'd only re-roll if da charge fell short.

prompt.kbm: Now move the squad. Drag each model — or just hit [b]Snap to Contact[/b] and the whole lot piles into base contact. The panel counts how many still need placing.
prompt.kbm_orky: Now shift da mob. Drag each model — or just hit [b]Snap to Contact[/b] an' da whole lot piles into base contact. Da panel counts how many still need placin'.
prompt.pad: Press {x} — that's [b]Snap to Contact[/b], it piles the whole squad in. ({a} grabs one model, {l3} swaps model, {b} undoes one.)
prompt.pad_orky: Press {x} — dat's [b]Snap to Contact[/b], it piles da whole mob in. ({a} grabs one model, {l3} swaps model, {b} undoes one.)

hint.text: [b]Undo Last Model[/b] takes back one drop if you put a model somewhere wrong.
hint.text_orky: [b]Undo Last Model[/b] takes back one drop if ya put a boy somewhere daft.

prompt.kbm: Hit [b]Confirm Charge Moves[/b] to finish the charge. The squad is now [b]in engagement[/b] — and charging units strike first in the Fight phase.
prompt.kbm_orky: Hit [b]Confirm Charge Moves[/b] to finish da charge. Da mob's now [b]in engagement[/b] — an' chargin' units strike first in da Fight phase.
prompt.pad: Press {menu} to [b]Confirm Charge[/b] once every declared target is reached.

prompt.kbm: The wagon and the grots aren't charging today. Hit the big red button to end the Charge phase.
